name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: An ancient rock fortress and palace ruin rising 200m above the central plains.

name: Galle Dutch Fort
description: A UNESCO World Heritage colonial fort on the southern coast, built by the Portuguese in 1588.

name: Yala National Park
description: Sri Lanka's most visited wildlife reserve, home to the world's highest density of leopards.

name: Temple of the Tooth
description: Sacred Buddhist temple housing the relic of the tooth of the Buddha, a UNESCO site.

name: Nine Arch Bridge
description: An iconic colonial-era railway viaduct in Ella surrounded by lush tea plantations.

name: Mirissa Beach
description: A crescent-shaped beach famous for whale watching and stunning sunsets over the Indian Ocean.

name: Dambulla Cave Temple
description: The largest and best-preserved cave temple complex in Sri Lanka with over 150 Buddha statues.
